content.description: The content of the PEM encoded certificate

is_ca.description: `true` if the certificate is of a CA (Certificate Authority).

issuer.description: Who verified and signed the certificate, roughly following [RFC2253](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2253).

not_after.description: The time until which the certificate is invalid, as an [RFC3339](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339) timestamp.

not_before.description: The time after which the certificate is valid, as an [RFC3339](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339) timestamp.

public_key_algorithm.description: The key algorithm used to create the certificate.

serial_number.description: Number that uniquely identifies the certificate with the CA's system. The `format` function can be used to convert this _base 10_ number into other bases, such as hex.

sha1_fingerprint.description: The SHA1 fingerprint of the public key of the certificate.

signature_algorithm.description: The algorithm used to sign the certificate.

subject.description: The entity the certificate belongs to, roughly following [RFC2253](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2253).

version.description: The version the certificate is in.

block.description: Parses a PEM encoded certificate to make various attributes available
